Title: FasmiFra molecule generator
Description: Assembles new molecules by recombining fragments cut from a reference set, using DeepSMILES to keep the resulting strings syntactically valid. Berenger and Tsuda designed FASMIFRA for speed, showing that straightforward fragment assembly can generate large libraries far faster than neural generators while preserving the distribution of properties found in the source molecules. Output resembles the input collection by construction, which limits novelty but keeps candidates within familiar chemistry.
Interpretation: Up to 100 generated molecules assembled by recombining fragments from a reference set.
